text: MAKES THE BACKLOG A TRACKED ITEM RATHER THAN ONLY A DOC. Full field-by-field state is docs/design/adr-0003-migration-status.md, re-audited 2026-08-29 09:35Z. MIGRATED TONIGHT, from zero: fidelityMass and fidelityByFacet (MassRatio, per-facet A_f is specified-verdict mass), compression and semanticFlowCoherence (MassRatio, ratio-of-sums), backwardMass and worldBackwardMass (StepMass). REMAINING, 14 fields: uniformCoverage and importanceWeightedCoverage (bare Double; importanceWeighted also has bd-01M16C9HT9V9Q80F7411V87BBY against it); specificity, worldChronology, causalPreservation (Option[Double]); discourseChronology (Option[Double], improved from bare Double but not migrated); the seven mass terms associationMass, intrusionMass, commentaryMass, sourceConsistentInferenceMass, uninterpretableMass, unrankedMass, distortedMass (bare Double); distortedMassByFacet and perUnitLocalizability (Map to Double). PLUS THE RESIDUAL: fidelity as a bare Option[Double] beside the supported fidelityMass is a clause-2 convenience leak - the library offers a way to quote the number without its support, which is what externalMass prevents by refusing a sum accessor. It was deliberately NOT blocked on, since the value it carries is now correct and blocking a strict improvement for incompleteness is an error already made once tonight; it goes with the rest of the Option fields. NOT urgent as a whole - these publish numbers that are correct but unsupported, unlike the zero-substitution defects already fixed - so this is a P2 backlog to be sliced, not a single candidate.
